neighbours.label: The token ' notice' (noun or verb)
fire: The landlord pinned a notice to the front door on Monday.
In a notice sent to parents, the school explained the new rules.
The company published a notice about the recall in the newspaper.
Few people notice the small plaque beside the entrance.
The court issued a notice to all creditors last week.
Visitors rarely notice the crack in the ceiling.
The council placed a notice in the window of the library.
She did not notice the car parked across the street.
quiet: The landlord pinned a letter to the front door on Monday.
In a message sent to parents, the school explained the new rules.
The company published a statement about the recall in the newspaper.
Few people read the small plaque beside the entrance.
The court issued a summons to all creditors last week.
Visitors rarely see the crack in the ceiling.
The council placed a poster in the window of the library.
She did not hear the car parked across the street.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (2.2% at 0.1 of max); ' notice' x5 among the peaks beside Korean, Chinese and Russian pieces, which this test does not cover. Probes: 'posted a notice' 0.51, 'Did you notice' 0.24, 'weeks of notice' 0.34 (peak on ' weeks'); 'posted a warning' 0.03.
